scan.title: Scan receipt
scan.intro: Take a clear photo of the whole receipt, flat and in good light.
scan.languageNote: Text is read on this phone. Printed English receipts work best. Bengali, Hindi and handwritten text usually can't be read — you can type those details in.

resume.title: Unfinished receipt
resume.message: You have a receipt that isn't saved yet.

cameraDenied.title: Camera access is off
cameraDenied.message: Allow camera access in Settings to photograph receipts, or choose a photo from the gallery.

unavailable.title: Receipt reading isn't available
unavailable.message: This version of the app can't read text from photos. You can still enter the receipt yourself.

timeout.title: Reading took too long
timeout.message: Try again with a sharper, well-lit photo, or enter the details yourself.

failed.title: Couldn't read the receipt
failed.message: Something went wrong while reading the photo. Try again or enter the details yourself.

tooSmall.title: Photo is too small
tooSmall.message: Take the photo closer so the text is large and sharp.

tooLarge.title: Photo is too large
tooLarge.message: Choose a smaller photo or take a new one.

invalidImage.title: Can't open this photo
invalidImage.message: Choose another photo or take a new one.

storage.title: Couldn't save the photo
storage.message: Your phone may be out of space. Free some space and try again, or enter the receipt without the photo.

review.title: Review receipt
review.noText: No text could be read from this photo. Enter the amount and details yourself.

totals.title: Totals
totals.none: No subtotal, tax or discount found.
totals.chooseTotal: Several totals were found. Which one did you pay?

issues.title: Please check
issues.totalAmbiguous: Several different totals were found. Choose or type the amount you paid.
issues.totalMissing: No total was found on the receipt. Enter the amount you paid.
issues.itemSuspicious: “{{name}}”: two different amounts on one line — it may be corrected or crossed out.
issues.itemsVsSubtotal: Items add up to {{items}}, but the subtotal is {{subtotal}}.
issues.totalsMismatch: Subtotal, tax and other lines add up to {{expected}}, not the amount entered.
issues.finalVsItems: Items add up to {{items}}, not the amount entered.
issues.finalVsExtracted: The total read from the receipt was {{amount}}.

review.confirmRequired: Tick “I've checked the amount” to save.
review.rescanMessage: Your changes to this receipt will be replaced by the new scan.
review.imageMissingMessage: The receipt photo is no longer on this phone. Save the expense without the photo?
review.duplicateMessage: A scanned receipt with the same date and amount is already saved. Save this one too?

detail.title: Receipt
detail.viewHint: Opens the receipt saved with this expense
detail.photoMissing: The photo is not available on this phone.
detail.amountDiffers: The expense amount ({{amount}}) is different from the receipt total read ({{read}}).
detail.removeMessage: The receipt photo and items are deleted. The expense stays.
